findings.message: AuthorGate.check writes tickets/<stem>/evidence/{replay.json,log.txt,report.json} into checkout.repo before validate_ticket runs. Nothing removes those files if validation, the bug-kind or player-prose checks, or requisition review rejects the candidate. They also stay when the author picks a different stem on retry, or when Author ends in failure_decision. Example: in test_report_author_failure_is_decision, the stem 'broken' passes stem_findings, so its evidence is written; the ticket text 'bad' then fails validation and the run ends as a decision. That leaves an untracked tickets/broken/evidence/ tree in the host checkout. Because `copied` lives only on this gate instance, any later AuthorGate refuses the stem 'broken' as 'already exists'. The working tree is left dirty and the commit's `only=` never picks these files up.
findings.paved_road: Copy custody evidence only for the candidate that will actually be committed: after the gate passes and before policy/review, or into a staging path that is cleaned up. Also remove the copied paths on every rejection, stem change, and failure_decision path, and add a test that a rejected or failed report attempt leaves no untracked files under tickets/.
